model.name: Classic-v2 recourse
model.pointsModel: stable season prior plus configured CatBoost fixture residual
model.quantiles: heuristic unconditional UI intervals; not calibrated decision intervals
model.reserveModel: position-specific 1-product(1-pDNP) under conditional independence; best-response roster selection and exact candidate rescoring
model.optimizer: sample-average preseason recourse with a separate legal HiGHS winter response per scenario
model.objective: average expected points across latent winter states with the opening slots shared across scenarios
model.starterEligibility: selectable and not currently injured, in rehabilitation, or not considered
model.historicalMarketSnapshots: unavailable; validation is experimental until archived snapshots exist

currentAvailabilitySignals.policy: current medical status overrides season hierarchy; missing return dates are never interpreted as healthy

currentSeasonEvidence.source: kicker current-season match artifacts plus inferred DNP for omitted squad players
currentSeasonEvidence.method: completed matches are replayed into recent role, points, appearance, and team-form state; a missing player row for a completed team fixture is treated as DNP; known rounds use realized roles/points, future role probabilities are anchored to observed selections, and already-played points are excluded from roster selection

validation.protocol: rolling-origin preseason selection followed by actual-cutoff state replay and legal winter reoptimization; baseline receives the same winter action space and exact reserve scoring
validation.historicalMarketSnapshots: unavailable: completed-season metadata is not proven to be a decision-time snapshot, so these results must not be described as leakage-safe

0003.fallbackReason: recourse challenger did not win the rolling-origin baseline ladder; stable forecasts are reoptimized with current availability

winterPlan.strategy: reoptimize from the actual opening slots at the winter deadline

rules.availabilityPolicy: current medical status blocks opening-roster selection

availabilityAudit.policy: Aktuell verletzte, im Aufbautraining befindliche oder nicht berücksichtigte Spieler sind für den Eröffnungskader und die vorab simulierte Winterphase gesperrt. Sperren werden spieltagsspezifisch berücksichtigt.
